note: Sophon is a POINTS farming system (points -> future L2 allocation); no direct token rewards on this contract. Threat ceilings are worst-case, not final severity.

candidates.title: withdraw omits boostAmount decrement (conservation break)
candidates.impact: user.amount reduced by withdrawAmount but user.boostAmount/pool.boostAmount never decremented -> boostAmount+depositAmount != amount; reward (points) weight accrues on phantom boost after withdraw
candidates.fund_loss: points-weight miscount; bounded by deposit (no direct token theft)

candidates.title: accPointsPerShare 1e18 scaling mismatch updatePool vs _pendingPoints
candidates.impact: updatePool writes pointReward/lpSupply (no extra 1e18); _pendingPoints view applies *1e18.../1e36 -> pendingPoints over-reports unsettled period ~1e18x; + truncation reward loss

candidates.title: depositStEth wraps full _amount vs actual stETH received (rebasing off-by-one)
candidates.impact: stETH transferFrom delivers _amount-1/2 wei; _stEthTOwstEth wraps full _amount -> revert (DoS) or consume residual/other-user stETH

candidates.title: boost inflates pool.amount reward denominator (synthetic, non-custody)
candidates.impact: pool.amount inflated by boost*boosterMultiplier/1e18 not matched by custody -> dilutes honest depositors' points share
candidates.fund_loss: points dilution; likely intended (paid boost feature)
candidates.intended_behavior: likely yes (boost is a paid amplifier)

candidates.title: setEndBlock _withdrawalBlocks=0 collapses withdrawal window
candidates.impact: owner can set 0-block withdrawal window -> users cannot withdraw depositAmount

candidates.title: add/set _withUpdate=false retroactive reward dilution
candidates.impact: changing totalAllocPoint without massUpdatePools mis-accrues elapsed window

candidates.title: heldProceeds under-withdraw (boosterMultiplier>1e18 strands surplus)
candidates.impact: owner withdraws less than true surplus; NOT user-deposit theft
